what_this_is: the first reach number on this project measured on a sample NOT chosen by the policy's author

design.sample: the first 60 MiniWob++ task files in filesystem walk order, alphabetic, truncated at the 60-task time budget. No task was dropped, added, or re-ordered after results were seen.
design.policy: one generic policy with five goal-shape procedures: Enter "X" (type), Select N with the slider (arrow keys), A>B>C (nested menu), Select X from the list (native select), drag with #draggableSmall (drag-box). Everything else falls through to a quoted-token click.
design.episodes: one attempt per task, as in a benchmark run

successes: (plus 2 more in the truncated head of the transcript)

the_number_that_matters_is_the_contrast.interpretation: the 60% figure was obtained on a set chosen BECAUSE earlier policies failed it and were then fixed until they passed. That is a tuning set. The 10% figure is the first estimate with no selection.

the_failure_taxonomy_at_scale.what_that_means: the task's goal sentence did not match any of five known shapes. This is a COVERAGE failure, not a perception, resolution, or learning failure. The agent never attempted 77% of the benchmark.
the_failure_taxonomy_at_scale.the_other_failures: the remaining 14 attempted tasks scored 6, so among ATTEMPTED tasks the rate is 6/14 = 43%. That is the more informative denominator for 'when the agent has a procedure, does it work', and it is still not a reach figure.

honest_reading: instant learning is real and was measured (one demonstration gave 2/6 -> 8/8 and transferred at 9/10; resolution raised a slider from 0/6 to 10/10). None of that changes the reach number, because reach is bounded by how many DIFFERENT task shapes the agent has a procedure for. Writing one procedure per goal shape does not scale to 130 tasks and does not generalise: this policy was authored with knowledge of the benchmark.
what_would_actually_raise_the_number: not more learning, and not more hand-written goal regexes. Either (a) a planner that decomposes an unseen goal sentence into the primitive operations it implies, or (b) a model that has been trained on the task distribution. (a) is the only one available with zero weights, and it is the honest target.
retracted_claims_this_supersedes: any implication that the project was near 60% or near 'solved' for computer use. The measured unselected reach is 10%.
